cases.question: According to the deployment guide, what are the steps to deploy the application?
expected_facts: Deploy API Gateway configuration first
then OCR Service workers
then verify Document Storage connectivity
Validate job submission and status through the API Gateway

supporting_chunks.text: Deploy API Gateway configuration first, then OCR Service workers, then verify Document Storage connectivity. Validate job submission and status through the API Gateway. Do not expose raw document content in Monitoring Service logs.

cases.question: Which teams own platform operations and security?
expected_facts: The Operations Team reviews security alerts and access logs
Platform Engineering Team patches Kubernetes nodes and maintains deployment controls
The Security Team reviews the API Gateway, Document Storage, and service identities

supporting_chunks.text: The Operations Team reviews security alerts and access logs. Platform Engineering Team patches Kubernetes nodes and maintains deployment controls. Security findings must be resolved before a release leaves the UAT Environment.

The Platform Engineering Team owns Kubernetes and the deployment pipeline. The Security Team reviews the API Gateway, Document Storage, and service identities. The Operations Team responds to Monitoring Service alerts. The UAT Environment mirrors the production flow for release validation.

expected_facts: Kubernetes worker pods reached their memory limit
jobs stayed pending
The API Gateway remained available

supporting_chunks.text: On 2025-04-18, a scheduled batch of 12,400 documents experienced elevated failures in the OCR Service. The API Gateway remained available, but Kubernetes worker pods reached their memory limit and jobs stayed pending.
